units.source_text: 且说太宰大弍出守筑紫，任期已满，于此时返京。

en.t: Now the Dazai no Daini, who had gone out to govern Tsukushi, had completed his term and was returning to the capital at this time.
A large company of relatives and attendants traveled with him.

units.source_text: 女儿甚多，不便陆行，故自夫人以下，女眷一概乘船，一路逍遥游览。

en.t: Because there were many daughters and land travel was inconvenient, all the women, from his wife downward, went by boat, leisurely enjoying the sights along the way.

units.source_text: 听说须磨风景优美，大家心甚向往。

en.t: Hearing that the scenery at Suma was beautiful, everyone longed very much to see it.

units.source_text: 闻得了源氏大将谪居于此的消息，那些多情的青年女郎虽然笼闭在船中，也都红晕满颊，装模作样起来。

en.t: When they heard that the Genji general was living here in exile, those romantic young ladies, though shut up inside the boat, all blushed deeply and began to put on affected airs.

units.source_text: 尤其是曾与源氏公子有缘的那位五节小姐，看见纤夫无情地拉过须磨浦边，心中好生惋惜。

en.t: In particular, the Lady of the Gosechi, who had once had a connection with Prince Genji, felt deep regret as she watched the boatmen heartlessly tow them past the shore of Suma.

units.source_text: 忽闻琴声远远地随风飘来。

en.t: Suddenly, the sound of a koto drifted from far away on the wind.

units.source_text: 四周风景的清丽、弹者风姿的优美，以及琴声的凄凉哀怨，并作一团，使得有心人都流下泪来。

en.t: The pure beauty of the surrounding scenery, the graceful appearance of the player, and the sorrowful melancholy of the koto sound blended together, bringing tears to everyone with a sensitive heart.
